findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Resolve the taxonomy/codec coupling: because set_pause (_ref_lock.py:717) is a live WRITE that mints gated_mode="reconcile-check" and _advisory_lock._mode_blocks resolves it via Mode.from_str, specify whether Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK / _ORDERED entry is retained (so the gate still resolves) or the pause codec's gated_mode literal is remapped, before removing the mode from the taxonomy.
evidence: Plan lists 'reconciler mode taxonomy' among live AC2 removal surfaces while carving out 'the historical pause-state decoder/writer lines around 658/717'
_ref_lock.py:717 `set_pause`: `doc = dict(zip(_PAUSE_FIELDS, ("reconcile-check", True, reason, who, paused_at) ...))` — writes the literal on EVERY new pause, not only historical reads
_advisory_lock.py:271 `gated_mode = mode_mod.Mode.from_str(gated_mode_str)`; on ValueError (line 272-277) it logs 'unrecognised mode ... treating as no gate' and returns False
mode.py:22 `_ORDERED=["reconcile-check", ...]` and mode.py:41 `RECONCILE_CHECK = "reconcile-check"` are the only definitions Mode.from_str/_ORDERED.index rely on
findings.finding: The Option B carve-out treats _ref_lock.py:717 as an inert historical decoder, but set_pause is a LIVE WRITE path that mints gated_mode="reconcile-check" on every new pause; removing RECONCILE_CHECK from the mode taxonomy (an in-scope AC2 surface) while retaining that writer breaks the pause gate, because _advisory_lock._mode_blocks resolves the stored gated_mode via Mode.from_str, which will then raise ValueError and silently treat active pauses as 'no gate'.
findings.location: Final AC2 Option B execution note / AC3 carve-out; interacts with src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/mode.py:22,41 and _ref_lock.py:717 + _advisory_lock.py:271
scenarios: After AC2 removal, an operator pauses the bridge; the next reconcile pass reads the pause blob, Mode.from_str('reconcile-check') raises, and _mode_blocks returns False, so a higher-mode run proceeds despite an active pause
findings.suggested_fix: Split the carve-out into READ vs WRITE: retain only the _decode_pause tolerance for historical gated_mode="reconcile-check" (AC3 read path), but either (a) keep Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK and its _ORDERED rank so Mode.from_str still resolves paused blobs, or (b) change set_pause to write a non-retired gated_mode value that remains in the taxonomy, so the live pause gate keeps enforcing after AC2 removal.
